meta.title: Laal — Every life is precious
meta.description: Everyone is someone’s Laal. Support real people facing difficult moments — every fundraiser is reviewed, and kindness reaches the right people, with dignity.

meta.title: Laal — Everyone is someone’s Laal
meta.description: Laal brings communities together to support families with dignity. Every need is verified, every act of kindness reaches the people who matter.

hero.title: Everyone is someone’s <laal>Laal</laal>.
hero.lead: A mother. A father. A child. A dream. Behind every request is a person who matters — and a community ready to stand with them.

values.reviewedBody: We verify the people and the need before any support is given.
values.kindnessBody: Funds go to a confirmed family member or trusted partner — never a stranger.
values.secureBody: Give safely in seconds. You always see where support is going.

what.title: A warm, trusted place to help
what.body: When a family faces a hard moment, they often carry costs, worry, and uncertainty all at once. Laal is a calm, caring way for friends and community to step in — every fundraiser is gently verified, and every act of kindness reaches the family who needs it.
what.imageAlt: A mother and father sharing a warm, playful moment with their young child at home

how.title: Four gentle steps
how.imageAlt: Three generations of a family laughing together, holding flowers

steps.startBody: A friend, colleague, or family member shares someone’s story in minutes.
steps.verifyBody: Our team gently confirms the people and the need before anything moves.
steps.giveBody: Supporters contribute securely — no account required to help.
steps.reachBody: Your contribution reaches a confirmed family member or trusted partner.

showcase.title: Carry their stories with you
showcase.body: The Laal app keeps you close to the people your community is standing with. Follow a family’s journey, and be there the moment they need you — wherever you are.
showcase.feature1: Browse verified fundraisers from your community
showcase.feature2: Follow a family’s journey and see support arrive
showcase.feature3: Help in seconds — securely, no account needed

featured.title: Fundraisers you can support
featured.emptyBody: New fundraisers are being reviewed. Check back soon to support someone precious.

cta.title: Be there when it matters most
cta.body: Share the story of someone you care about, or stand with a family in their hardest moment. Small kindness, life-changing impact.
cta.imageAlt: Two hands reaching toward one another against a warm sunset sky

mockup.lead: People in your community you can stand with.
mockup.story: Amir worked far from home to give his children a future. His family hopes to bring him back to rest among the people who loved him. Every contribution is reviewed and reaches his family with care.
mockup.beneficiary: Support reaches {name}, a confirmed family member.
mockup.ctaNote: Secure · every fundraiser reviewed before support
mockup.heroAlt: The Laal app showing reviewed fundraisers you can support
mockup.showcaseAlt: The Laal app showing a reviewed fundraiser and a Help Now button

thankYou.metaTitle: Thank you for your kindness — Laal
thankYou.title: Thank you for protecting someone precious.
thankYou.body1: Your contribution is held securely and reaches the family we support.
thankYou.body2: You helped remind someone they are not alone. On behalf of the family, thank you.
thankYou.paidBody: Your support of {amount} for {title} has been received.
thankYou.pendingTitle: Your bank is completing the transfer
thankYou.pendingBody: Thank you for standing with this family. Your bank is still completing the transfer, so it isn’t final yet — we’ll email you the moment it clears.
thankYou.neutralBody: If you just completed a contribution, it will appear on the fundraiser shortly. Nothing is charged until your payment is confirmed.
thankYou.receiptSent: A receipt is on its way to the email address you gave.
thankYou.receiptNone: You didn’t add an email address, so there’s no receipt to send — your support still counts.
thankYou.next1: Your contribution is held securely by Laal — never in anyone’s personal account.
thankYou.next2: The fundraiser is reviewed and the need verified before anything is released.
thankYou.next3: Funds are then released to the family, and the fundraiser's total goes up.
thankYou.shareBody: Sharing takes seconds and brings the family closer to what they need.
thankYou.shareMessage: I just supported {title} on Laal. Everyone is someone’s Laal — will you stand with them too? {url}

start.title: Start a fundraiser
start.lead: Tell us about your loved one and the family who needs support. We carefully review every fundraiser before it goes live, with care for their dignity.

form.storyHint: Tell us who they were and how this support will help their family.
form.deathCountryHint: Where the death occurred, as shown on the death certificate
form.deathCityHint: The city where the death occurred, even if the deceased has since been moved
form.repatriationCityHint: The city where the deceased will be taken for burial

beneficiary.heading: Who receives the support?
beneficiary.description: Choose a verified partner organisation, or a person such as yourself or a family member.
beneficiary.displayNameLabel: Name of the person we'll support
beneficiary.displayNameHint: Shown publicly, so “Family of Ahmed K.” is enough — please leave out full legal names, phone numbers, emails and addresses.

cover.label: Cover photo (optional)
cover.hint: A photo of your loved one helps people connect with their story. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 20MB.
cover.tooLarge: This photo is too large (max {maxMb}MB). Please choose a smaller one.
